empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable block of review instructions that any agent can attach.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit, preview or version it.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.body: “{name}” will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.linked: {count, plural, =0 {It is not linked to any agent.} one {It is linked to # agent, which will stop using it.} other {It is linked to # agents, which will stop using it.}}

form.name: Name
form.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every new branch that no test covers.
form.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: what the agent must check or do. This is the skill's interface.
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what to flag, at which severity, and how to report it…

import.hint: A single markdown file, or an archive with a SKILL.md. Up to 512 KB. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 512 KB.
import.trustBody: An imported skill is someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before saving. It is saved disabled — enable it once you trust it.
import.ignored: {count, plural, one {# ignored file} other {# ignored files}} — never executed or stored
import.importedToast: Skill “{name}” imported — it is disabled until you enable it

notFound.title: Skill not found
notFound.body: This skill doesn't exist — it may have been deleted.

config.versionHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save of a changed body is snapshotted, so a review run stays reproducible against the exact text it used.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.restoreBody: The body of v{version} becomes a new version. The history is kept.
versions.noChanges: No differences from the current body.
